GK drill

Glove Save

Hold and drag to set your dive: the direction is where you drag, the reach is how far. Let go to dive. A full stretch takes longer to get there than a hop, so the corner has to be left for early. Ten shots.

Trains Reflexes. Today's ten count once, 5 wins pay +1 and 8 pay +2 with next season's growth, never past your ceiling. Practice is free and banks nothing.

tackle:intro:
CB drill
🦵

Tackle

He runs across you and every touch pushes the ball off his feet for a moment. Tap the ball, not the man, while it is loose. Tap him, or go through the ball while it sits at his feet, and it is a foul. Ten runs.

Trains Defending. Today's ten count once, 5 wins pay +1 and 8 pay +2 with next season's growth, never past your ceiling. Practice is free and banks nothing.

throughball:intro:
🎯 Through Ball

Ten runs. Your runner starts onside, waits a moment, then cuts in across the defensive line. Drag on the pitch to the spot you want the ball to stop: where you drag is the direction, how far is the weight. Let go to play it.

A pass scores 10 when it goes through a gap in the line, stops short of the keeper and lands on his run in time. Play it after he crosses the line and he is offside. Too soft and it dies before the line or behind him; too hard and it runs to the keeper or away from him. Off the side of the pitch is out of play. Later runs are quicker and the gaps get tighter. The clock and his timings stay on screen the whole run, including with reduced motion.

Drag and let go with a mouse or a finger. Or focus the pitch: Left and Right turn the aim, Up and Down set the weight, Space starts the run and plays the pass. The buttons under the pitch do the same. Pause freezes the clock, and coming back from another tab needs Resume.

Today's ten save after every ball and can bank once. Practice is unlimited and never banks. One career session per season: 50 earns +1 Passing, 80 earns +2, capped by your ceiling, with next season's growth.

Example: he goes at 1.00s and crosses the line at 2.40s. Play it at about 2.20s into the space a step ahead of his run, through the gap, and he takes it in stride for 10. The same pass at 2.50s is offside.

wallshot:intro:
ST drill
🧱

Wall Shot

A wall with a gap that opens and closes. Drag the goal to aim across and up, set your power, and let go as the gap opens. Pace gets there sooner and sprays wider. Ten shots.

Trains Shooting. Today's ten count once, 5 wins pay +1 and 8 pay +2 with next season's growth, never past your ceiling. Practice is free and banks nothing.
